note: Angola: nationals of Namibia, Mozambique, São Tomé, South Africa and Zambia enter without a visa by bilateral agreement; nationals of the countries the Government lists enter without one for 30 days a visit (no more than 90 a calendar year, not modelled); everyone else applies online for a pre-visa (a 30-day tourist visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Serviço de Migração e Estrangeiros' own eVisa page and the Government's notice of Presidential Decree 189/23: nationals of the countries it lists are exempt from a tourist visa for up to 30 days an entry and 90 a year; the list names every passport held for it but Hong Kong's, the Philippines' and Samoa's, which Wikipedia's copy, read before, had among them and which were moved to the e-Visa (American Samoa's, the Cook Islands' and Niue's are their states' here). The bilateral exemptions' lengths and the e-Visa's 30 days stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Portal Oficial do Governo de Angola, Angola isenta cidadãos de 98 países de vistos de turismo (02-10-2023)
sources.said: De acordo com Decreto Presidencial n.º 189/23, publicado em Diário da República, os cidadãos de países beneficiários poderão usufruir da isenção de vistos de turismo, podendo permanecer até 30 dias por entrada e até 90 dias por ano.
